Name: All Artifacts in Geodes
Author: xAEVEx
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=5][b]Now updated for Game Version 1.1
[/b][/size][/color]


Does this ever happened to you? You are trying to complete the Museumscollection and hunt for worm tiles in an specific area. After days of waiting there finally appeared on and what did it drop? a bunch of clay...

Not uncommon since the droprate for artifacts is mostly at around 1%.

But what will you do if there is this one specific artifact wich is missing in your collection?




[size=3][u][b]Option 1:[/b][/u][/size]
Leave this Mod and search for an inventor editor (there are plenty of them... to get the geodes and money for testing i used "Chicklet"...)
[size=1]
[/size][i][color=#00ff00][size=1]but hey, isnt that cheating? what if i want to earn my artifacts by my own?
Of course, many people will call that cheating and dont even spent much time thinking about doing so...
and thats where Option 2 takes part![/size][/color][color=#00ff00]
[/color]




[/i][size=3][u][b]Option 2:[/b][/u][/size]
You download here the Mod you want (more below) and go for Geode Farming!

[size=3][u]Let's go into detail:[/u][/size]
You have 3 Mods to chose from:

1:
The first one let's the Magma Geode drop all possible artifacts (see pictures). And by all i mean all, except the somewhere else hardcoded stuff like stones or similiar, the Magma Geode will [b][u]only[/u][/b] drop artifacts (all 42 if i didnt forgott one). But don't worry, all Gems and Minerals have been [u]added[/u] to the Frozen Geode, so it will drop everything from the vanilla Frozen and vanilla Magma Geode.

2:
The other one is made after i realised that the magma Geode is quite easy to obtain... So for those who want a harder challenge for Geode-Artifact hunting is this the right one.
In this version its the rare Omni Geode wich will drop the Artifacts (again expect somtimes stone and co, since that is somewhere else saved). And Magma Geode wich drops the vanilla Magma and vanilla Omni Geode loot.

3:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29119680]lorditchy[/url] asked for an Mod version wich only adds the Artifacts to the Omni Geode without changing anything else.
Be aware that the loottable of this Geode contains now over 90 items, so it might take a while until you get what you want







[size=5][u][b]How to Install:[/b][/u][/size]
0. Backup the File or download the original backup i've added as optional File
1. Download the Mod wich fits for you
2. extract the zip to you gamefolder (mostly "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley")
3. Overwrite the "ObjectInformation.xnb"
4. Enjoy the hunt :)



[size=4][u][b]
Incompatible Mods:[/b][/u][/size]
So far i dont know mods wich are incompatible with this, but every mod that make changes to the "ObjectInformation.xnb" should be incompatible...
However, its just a bit editing to make an compatibility version, so if that occurs to you just write it here and i'll try to get in contact with the other modder to make that happen ;)
